causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: This was largely due to an unexpected fall in wind output which began at 11.30 pm on 17 December.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: There was an unplanned outage to the Murraylink interconnector between 2 and 20 December. This reduced South Australia's access to cheap generation from Victoria by 220 MW, Murraylink's nominal limit.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: These factors, combined with market participants rebidding roughly 135 MW of capacity to high prices, contributed to the 1 am 30-minute price exceeding $5,000/MWh.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: Subsequently, fast-start' units received a signal to come on but required 10 to 15 minutes before they could begin generating.

interconnectors_named.name: Murraylink
interconnectors_named.quote: There was an unplanned outage to the Murraylink interconnector between 2 and 20 December.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood
interconnectors_named.quote: The remaining interconnector linking South Australia to Victoria, the Heywood interconnector, was operating at 544 MW at 12.30 am, close to its 600 MW nominal capacity.

intervals.quote: The 30-minute price in South Australia was $5,715/MWh at 1 am on 18 December 2021. This was driven by two 5-minute prices of $10,247/MWh and $15,098/MWh at 12.50 am and 12.55 am respectively.

network_outages.quote: There was an unplanned outage to the Murraylink interconnector between 2 and 20 December. This reduced South Australia's access to cheap generation from Victoria by 220 MW, Murraylink's nominal limit.

peak_price.quote: This was driven by two 5-minute prices of $10,247/MWh and $15,098/MWh at 12.50 am and 12.55 am respectively.
